_comment: Source-of-truth content for the audience profile pages. Edited by hand today; designed to be written by the KoyaOS consulting loop later. build-profiles.py renders one static page per entry. The root general page is hand-maintained separately (see PROFILES.md).

_schema.accent: primary brand hex, used for buttons, links, card borders, focus
_schema.open_cards: Ordered role cards: title, subject, sub, body
_schema.achievements: master board: {title, blurb, audiences[], metric?, link?} rendered at /achievements/. link makes the title open an external URL.
_schema.work_ids: Ordered stable achievement IDs resolved by the renderer into audience work cards

achievements.title: Fuwari: live grooming software, web and iPhone
achievements.blurb: Built and operate Fuwari, the grooming platform originally called GroomBook. Re-platformed the customer web app onto Next.js and Supabase with a verified no-data-loss cutover. Extended it with an AI assistant, scheduling, messaging, financial workflows, and a native iPhone app available to external testers through TestFlight. The customer web app is live; the iPhone app is in external beta.
achievements.metric: Live customer web app | iPhone external beta

achievements.title: Stonewise: live kidney-stone care companion
achievements.blurb: Built Stonewise as an installable web app for organizing kidney-stone care: hydration logging and pacing, meal tracking, lab-result trends, daily plans, and backup and restore. AI-assisted report and meal input asks the user to check extracted information before saving. The web app is live; a native iPhone app remains planned. Designed for personal organization and evidence-aware decision support.
achievements.metric: Live installable web app | native iPhone app planned

achievements.title: ChildCareOS: private operations platform
achievements.blurb: Built a private web platform for childcare operations, covering administration, educator and parent workflows, messaging, and access controls. The private web release is deployed. Physical acceptance and the parent mobile release remain separate milestones. Public demonstrations use synthetic data.
achievements.metric: Private web release | mobile and physical acceptance pending

achievements.title: Signal Engine: local video evidence through MCP
achievements.blurb: Built a local evidence-intake system that extracts audio from public video links, transcribes with whisper.cpp, and retains transcripts, summaries, and source provenance. Integrated it with Claude Code and a Claude Desktop extension through MCP. It is a local operating capability, not a public SaaS.
achievements.metric: Local MCP integration | transcript and provenance artifacts

achievements.title: Playing for Keeps: live fantasy-hockey application
achievements.blurb: Built and operate a complete fantasy-hockey league application with custom roster and contract rules, salary-cap accounting, fee tracking, authentication, and chat. Built using AI throughout development and used by a real league. I own the architecture, implementation, testing, release, and maintenance.

achievements.title: AgAR: field and greenhouse scouting prototype
achievements.blurb: Designed and built an agricultural scouting prototype across mobile, web, voice, and workflow dispatch. The current public site explains field and greenhouse use cases with prototype labels. The earlier hosted data backend is retired; this is development evidence, not a claim of a live grower deployment.

achievements.title: AIVA Network: startup ecosystem workflows
achievements.blurb: As Ecosystem Manager for the AIVA Network at EMILI, worked across startup outreach, evaluation, and pilot routing. Built Airtable workflows for startup intake, relationship tracking, operating records, and follow-through.
achievements.metric: Ecosystem operations | Airtable CRM and automation

achievements.title: AgXactly: founder, just under US$1M raised
achievements.blurb: Founded and led an agtech precision-data company across Canada and the US, raising just under US$1M and taking it through acquisition by Nighthawk Ag. Continued working in the combined business, which later wound down. FI included AgXactly in its Select Portfolio and its 2022 Canadian growth list; Loyal VC lists it as an FI-referred investment.
achievements.metric: Just under US$1M raised | acquired by Nighthawk Ag

achievements.title: Founder Institute: alumnus and mentor
achievements.blurb: Finished the FI program with the highest cumulative judge-rated pitch score in a cohort of more than 100 startups and founders. Ryan Micheletti advised me during the program. Later invited to mentor FI's Global Food Ecosystems program, with a Vision session invitation and scheduled founder office hours.
achievements.metric: Highest end-of-program pitch score | returned as mentor

achievements.title: KoyaOS: venture workflow architecture
achievements.blurb: Designed and built venture-scoped context, research and source records, decision logs, agent workflows, review gates, and handoffs. The current studio runs through repositories and maintained evidence. The earlier hosted Mission Control dashboard is retired and retained as historical source, not the current operating authority.
achievements.metric: Agent workflows | evidence and continuity systems

achievements.title: Corbel: AI systems and operating work
achievements.blurb: Built an AI consulting practice around understanding business workflows, reviewing existing systems, and implementing useful software and automation. Work spans product delivery, CRM architecture, documentation, verification, and ongoing operations.
achievements.metric: Workflow research | product and operating systems

achievements.title: Ramara Hub: civic information work
achievements.blurb: Built a civic information platform with researched issue briefs, public-document references, and answers linked to official sources. The project demonstrates retrieval, citation discipline, and translating complex public information into a usable interface. Current feature availability is separate from the original build evidence.

achievements.title: Parallel Human: venture and AI research
achievements.blurb: Founded Parallel Human as a place to build ventures and study what AI changes about founder work. The public site presents an evidence-led research posture. My product work and operating methods provide practical experience alongside that research.
achievements.metric: Founder work | AI research and product execution

achievements.title: Auction Advisor: completed build, now archived
achievements.blurb: Built auction intelligence that compared listings with retail evidence and retained bid trails. The project is now archived and its hosted backend retired. It remains an example of data pipelines, provenance, incident recovery, and careful handling of automation.

achievements.title: F1 Fantasy Optimizer: personal project
achievements.blurb: Built a personal fantasy-lineup tool for race-weekend decisions. The hosted accounts and persistence backend is retired. Retained as a personal product and data-work example, not an active commercial offering.

achievements.title: Life Archive: local archive tooling
achievements.blurb: Built local tooling for organizing scattered digital history and finding earlier information. The work includes archive recovery, searchable source records, and a local operator interface. It is local development work, not a launched public service.

achievements.title: OrganicGrow Solutions: earlier founder experience
achievements.blurb: Built a soil-amendment and organic nutrient business, combining product development, testing and certifications with grower relationships and sales. This work led into the data and crop-insight problems that became AgXactly.

achievements.title: Vesta.AI: early AI venture and a hard lesson
achievements.blurb: Founded a restaurant smart-speaker ordering venture before today's frontier-model tools. The business failed when the technical delivery could not match the promise. That experience drove me to become capable of building and verifying the systems myself.

achievements.title: Enterprise sales: infrastructure and cybersecurity
achievements.blurb: Sold enterprise packaging systems, telecom and cloud services, and cybersecurity engagements. Held commercial leadership responsibilities and carried those customer, negotiation, and relationship skills into founder-led businesses.

ai_practice.title: How I build with AI
ai_practice.intro: I use AI across research, product design, development, and operations to build complete applications that work in the real world. Without traditional software-engineering training, I have carried products from customer workflow and architecture through implementation, testing, release, and maintenance. I own the decisions and verify the results.

sections.title: The tools, and what I use them for
sections.body: Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and OpenAI Codex support research, specifications, code, reviews, and operating work. MCP connects agents to tools and local systems; Signal Engine turns public video into source-backed artifacts. Agent Reach supports public-web research. I have also configured a local DeepSeek Harness for browser workflows and evaluated Jev through Vercel AI Gateway for bounded, typed decisions using synthetic examples.

sections.title: From customer workflow to running software
sections.body: I start with the real workflow, map the data and product boundaries, and write a scoped specification. I give agents focused context and acceptance criteria, inspect their changes, and test the result. The stack includes TypeScript, React, Next.js, Supabase/Postgres, and Vercel; Airtable and Attio support relationship and operating workflows.

sections.title: Proof before release
sections.body: I use automated tests, Playwright browser checks, source citations, independent reviews, written cutover plans, backups, and rollback paths where the change requires them. Agents help implement and challenge the work. I own the decisions and verify what users actually receive.
